name: Chooms!
author: Edgemodders
description: Night City's social feed, a mobile app for EDGEmobile's phone. People V has met, the corporations and the gangs of V's district post by themselves every few minutes, written by REDagent with your Anthropic key (each post costs a little; a daily cap is in the settings). This package keeps your feed for each playthrough and holds its settings. Open Chooms! on the phone.
